name: Pokémon Horizons
description: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

videos.title: Pocket Monsters New Year Special
videos.overview: 2024 means the Pokémon anime, too! Here's a new year's special that will raise the roof with song! Tetsuro Degawa, Eiji Wentz and Miki will try singing the ending theme "RVR: Rising Volt Tacklers Rap!" Will they succeed?! yama x Botchi Boromaru will also perform a special live version of the opening theme "Halo!" And we'll get a special edition of Professor Friede's Pokémon Seminar presenting anime news as well!

videos.title: Pokemon Get & Big Frolic in the Hot Spring Town! A Special Full of Heart and Body Power!
videos.overview: Today's theme is "Wellbeing with Pokémon"! Some very well known popular comedians conduct a search for the Legendary Pokemon Terapagos that's hiding in the resort surrounding the picturesque Kusatsu Onsen! Catch the 18 different types of Pokémon with Pokémon Go and get hints towards its location! Tough trials also await on this wellbeing journey of walking and discovery! If they manage to find Terapagos, they'll be treated to an extravagant gourmet meal! But if they don't, what awaits them will be a freezing cold...?! A certain group of Pokémon will also make an appearance at Kusatsu! How will this grand adventure end?!

videos.title: Pokémon Music Fest
videos.overview: From the theme song for the new chapter airing from May 22nd, to opening and ending themes, and even Pokémon songs by renowned international artists! Also, don't miss the new song project featuring the names of all 1025 Pokémon! With Pokémon talk segments, rap and dance corners, we'll create a festival-like atmosphere where everyone can sing and dance along. Join the beloved Pokémon of the world and today's hottest artists and guests to make the "Pokémon Music Fest" a huge success!

videos.title: Special Party! Full of Pokémon!!
videos.overview: A special episode of "Pocket Monsters" that will make you laugh, be surprised, and have fun with both Pokémon and their trainers! A huge gathering of unique Pokémon! What kind of unexpected events await us? Let's all go on a Wonder Voyage together!

videos.title: Reboot! Off to the World of Adventure!!
videos.overview: Now that their adventure in Rakua is over, Liko and the others have just been sitting around absentmindedly without doing much of anything. However, one day Friede visits them and invites them along for some fieldwork to investigate an amazing Pokémon. That Pokémon turns out to be a Hinbass...

videos.title: Enter the Fake Rising Volteccers!?
videos.overview: News of the Rising Volt Tacklers helping people has become the talk of the town all over... however, Liko and the others have absolutely no idea what these stories are referring to. Could there be impostors around...? The group head off to investigate in order to find out what's going on... and believe it or not, while they're asking around for information, they discover a second Brave Asagi?! Just who are the Fake Rising Volt Tacklers...?

videos.title: The Secret Metamon Rhapsody
videos.overview: Laudbon and the others are starving, but as they search for berries, a Metamon who's tried to Transform into Cap appears before them. The naive and childlike Metamon quickly befriends the Pokémon from the airship, however...

videos.title: Clap Clap Clap! Mini Gurumin!!
videos.overview: Metamon crashes one of Gurumin's livestreams after having tried to Transform into her. Dot gets upset about this and wants to pretend it never happened, but the "Mini-Gurumin" incident actually becomes quite the talk of of town in her fandom... so Dot decides to take Metamon along for the bread festival she's been invited to hold a show at...

videos.title: READY GO! Unite Battle!!
videos.overview: Liko and the others land on Aeos Island! There, Liko, Roy, Dot, Uruto and Friede will try their hands at a Unite Battle!

videos.title: Miare City! New Encounters
videos.overview: Liko and the others have arrived in Miare City,and go visit the Handsome House, where they meet Matiere and her assistant Navi. Navi really loves Pokémon,and takes a great interest in Liko and the others. Just then, Matiere receives a request to locate a Melecie. And when the group starts investigating, they learn that a large blonde man wearing a dougi was accompanying it.

videos.title: A Dream Ball for You!
videos.overview: Navi is really depressed due to losing the Dream Ball. It was really dear to her, as she had been given it by Matiere so that she'd one day use it to catch hold of her dream... Meanwhile, Metamon picks up the Dream Ball Navi dropped on the airship and decides to head off to Miare City all by itself in order to return it to her...! Will Metamon be able to find Navi and return the Dream Ball safe and sound?!

videos.title: Navi's Little Big Adventure!
videos.overview: Navi has got Metamon and become a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers! The upfront and enthusiastic Navi immediately hits it off with the rest of the crew, but just doesn't seem to click with Uruto... Liko suggests the two of them run an errand in the nearby town, but as expected, they end up fighting again! But when Navi goes off on her own, she ends up getting lost?!

videos.title: Shocking! Mega Rayquaza and the Mysterious Land!?
Wanival and Dekanuchan's Great Sleep Operation!
videos.overview: Just as Wanival and Dekanuchan are suffering from sleep deprivation, Liko and the others run into Professor Neroli, a researcher of Pokémon sleeping. They all travel together to Wakakusa Island to try using the power of the Kabigon there to put Wanival and Dekanuchan to sleep, but the hungry Kabigon ends up waking up... and the group starts working on trying to make Comatose Butter Curry in order to fill it up and make it go back to sleep!!

videos.title: Super Emotional! Pokémon Contest!!
videos.overview: Liko decides to enter a Pokémon Contest with Masquernya, Laudbon and Wanival! And after getting trained by the self-styled "coach" Navi, it's finally time for the real deal! The venue is filled with skilled performers, last but not least the Pikachu idol group "Cutie Pikapika", and Liko starts feeling quite uneasy as she watches them perform...
